name: @axcore/xicons
description: Developer icon registry with original, mono, and branded SVG variants.

scripts.lint: pnpm run generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm run generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts
